title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 50
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 50: the word against Babylon and the Chaldeans, and the promise of return for Israel and Judah.

questions.text: This word that Yahweh spoke by Jeremiah concerns which city and land?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 50:1 says this is the word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

answers.text: Egypt, the land of the Nile
Moab and all its cities, far and near
Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans
Edom and the inhabitants of Teman

questions.text: Which two are named as disappointed and dismayed when Babylon is taken?
questions.explanation: The message to publish is: Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed.

answers.text: Bel and Merodach
Chemosh and Malcam
Amon and Pharaoh
Hamath and Arpad

questions.text: From which direction does the nation come up against her?
questions.explanation: A nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate so that no one will dwell in it.

answers.text: Out of the south
Out of the east
Out of the sea
Out of the north

questions.text: What does Yahweh call his people, and what have their shepherds done?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says his people have been lost sheep, and their shepherds have caused them to go astray and turned them away on the mountains.

answers.text: A strong vine that their keepers pruned
Lost sheep, whose shepherds caused them to go astray
A flock that their shepherds gathered home
A city that its builders finished

questions.text: What are they told to be like when they flee out of the middle of Babylon?
questions.explanation: They are told to flee out of the middle of Babylon and to be as the male goats before the flocks.

answers.text: The doves of the valleys
The lions of the forest
The male goats before the flocks
The eagles of the sky

questions.text: Who first devoured Israel, the hunted sheep, before Nebuchadnezzar broke his bones?
questions.explanation: The text says the king of Assyria devoured him first, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.

answers.text: The king of Assyria
Pharaoh king of Egypt
The king of Moab
The Philistines

questions.text: What will be sought for and not found in those days?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says the iniquity of Israel will be sought for and there will be none, and the sins of Judah will not be found, for he will pardon the remnant he leaves.

answers.text: The ark of the covenant of Yahweh
The iniquity of Israel and the sins of Judah
The walls and the gates of Babylon
The kings and princes of the Chaldeans

questions.text: What is Babylon called, that is cut apart and broken?
questions.explanation: The text exclaims: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

answers.text: The lion of the nations
The tower of the peoples
The shield of the east
The hammer of the whole earth

questions.text: Which creatures will dwell in her when she is inhabited no more?
questions.explanation: The wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there, and the ostriches will dwell in her.

answers.text: Sheep and cattle from the hills of Ephraim
Doves and sparrows from the valleys
Wild animals of the desert, wolves and ostriches
Horses and camels of the people of the east

questions.text: What happens at the noise of the taking of Babylon?
questions.explanation: The last verse says that at the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth trembles, and the cry is heard among the nations.

answers.text: The earth trembles and the cry is heard among the nations
The sea is divided before the nations
The sun goes dark over the land of the Chaldeans
The walls of Jerusalem fall to the ground
